title: {{name}} and the Big Match
text:
{{name}} loved soccer very much. Every day after school, {{name}} ran to the field. The big match was on Saturday. {{name}}'s team was going to play the best team in town.

But there was a problem. {{name}} was not good at scoring goals. The other kids could kick the ball far. {{name}} always missed the net. Some kids said, "You should sit and watch."

{{name}} felt sad. But {{name}} did not give up. "I must try harder," said {{name}}.

Every day, {{name}} did some practice. {{name}} kicked the ball again and again. When the sun went down, {{name}} still played. {{name}}'s legs were tired, but the heart was strong.

On Saturday, the big match began. Both teams ran fast. The score was zero to zero. Then the ball came to {{name}}!

"You should kick now!" yelled a friend. {{name}} took a deep breath. {{name}} ran to the ball. When the moment came, {{name}} kicked it hard.

The ball flew up. It went into the net! Goal! {{name}}'s team won the big match!

All the kids ran to {{name}}. They were so happy. "You did it!" they said. "You never gave up!"

{{name}} smiled. Hard work is the best way. A good friend helps too. And soccer is the most fun game in the world!
